description: The top 10 players of one open slate by projection, and the top 10 by value (projected points per $1,000 of salary; on the NFL, at most 2 of each position), with each player's salary and projection. `optimizer` is the free optimizer of this slate: the user builds up to 20 lineups there with his own locks and caps, with no account. The full player pool, with projected ownership, needs an account.
name: top_players
title: Top players
